name: Components
variables_and_defaults: BPC_Health: MaxHP=100, CurrentHP=100, MaxShield=0, CurrentShield=0, bIsInvulnerable=false, bDeathTriggered=false
BPC_WeaponInventory: ActiveWeaponIndex=0, CurrentAmmo=30, bCanFire=true, DamageMultiplier=1, FireRateMultiplier=1, ProjectileSpeedMultiplier=1, BonusPierce=0, BonusProjectiles=0
functions_and_dispatchers: BPC_Health funcs: InitializeHealth, ApplyDamage, Heal, SetInvulnerable, RestoreFull, IsDead; dispatchers OnHealthChanged, OnShieldChanged, OnDamaged, OnDeath
BPC_Targeting funcs: StartTargeting, StopTargeting, RefreshTarget, ClearTarget, GetAimDirection; dispatcher OnTargetChanged
BPC_WeaponInventory funcs: LoadWeaponByRow, SelectWeaponIndex, RequestFire, Reload, SetAmmo, ApplyWeaponModifier; dispatchers OnWeaponChanged, OnAmmoChanged, OnFireRequested
BPC_Experience funcs: AddXP, GetXPRequiredForLevel, ResetRunXP; dispatchers OnXPChanged, OnLevelChanged, OnLevelUpRequested
BPC_Inventory funcs: AddItem, ConsumeItem, GetCount, ClearInventory; dispatcher OnItemCountChanged
BPC_StatusEffects funcs: AddTimedStatus, RemoveStatus, HasStatus; dispatchers OnStatusAdded, OnStatusRemoved
BPC_CardModifiers funcs: CanApplyCard, ApplyCard, GetCardStack, ClearRunCards; dispatcher OnCardApplied
data_rows_or_constants: XP formula seed: XPToNext = Round(100 * Pow(1.22, Level-1))
hard_rules: Do not guess missing asset paths
Do not redo assets already marked PASS
